'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Michael Pistone DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Pistone]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: SEE LS TITLE.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal]]
* '''Username:''' PISTONE 84
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
